Her childhood rebelliousness was due to my lack of guidance; her current fall from the path is due to my soft-hearted indulgence. The responsibility lies entirely with me—what does it have to do with her?”
“From beginning to end, she has been a person of Fumeng Mountain. Even if she falls into the Ghost Path, she shall be dealt with by me. None of you have the right to punish her in the slightest.”
The crowd stared at the dragon patterns on He Shu’s sword, then looked at the “foul snake” behind her who was about to sprout dragon horns. They realized then: these two were simply irredeemable lunatics.
“My little Hong only needs to grow up happily.” “Senior Sister is my favorite person; even in death, I must protect her.”

166691.synopsis:
Unemployed, impoverished, and with only 200 yuan left, Fang Yuebai was bound to the [Unlimited Ingredient Blind Box System] , thinking she was about to turn her life around.
However, her newbie gift pack turned out to be a dilapidated 15-square-meter shop with peeling paint, along with LV1 privileges that only allowed her to draw “ordinary eggs + wilted cabbage.”
System notification: Food ingredients must not be taken out of the store.
Fang Yuebai looked at the wilted cabbage in her hand and gritted her teeth. “Fine. Then I’ll use this old pot to make fried rice in this run-down shop!”
The first batch was burnt on the outside and undercooked on the inside, but she swallowed it anyway.
…It wasn’t until the eighth batch that the aroma of eggs finally wafted out of the shabby little shop.
—Ding! System reward: 1 bunch of Exquisite green onions.
The first bowl of egg fried rice was tasted by Uncle Chen, who happened to be passing by and had already eaten.
The old man froze for a moment, then cleared his throat. “Give me another bowl.”
Starting with that bowl of fried rice, Zhao Fengxia, who was stubborn yet soft-hearted; Sister Deng, who loved to gossip; and Xiao Jie, who was special… all became regulars at this humble shop.
Some say that the food at Yuebai Restaurant tastes like home.
But trouble soon comes knocking—rumors begin to spread about the shop, and delivery drivers retaliate…
Aunt Feng shares her treasured recipes with her. He Mu hacks into the system to help uncover the truth. And all the old neighbors on the street step forward to support her.
Fang Yuebai looks at the small restaurant in front of her and suddenly smiles.
The system may only provide the ingredients, but what they provide is the reason this shop survives.

Common → Good → Excellent → Exquisite → Superior → Rare → Precious → Legendary → Epic → Mythical

Welcome to Yuebai Restaurant.

177443.synopsis:
Q: What’s it like to be a butler in a rich family’s home?
A: Thanks for the invite. I’m currently at the Wayne Manor in Gotham, and I’ve already set the child welfare hotline as a speed dial ?
First, a brief introduction: I am an outstanding employee in the CEO-Domination Literature Division of the Quick-Travel Bureau. I have previously served in popular support roles—such as special assistant, executive assistant, and butler—under CEOs Gu, Xie, Shen, and Duan.
I’m proficient in skills such as “The young master hasn’t laughed like this in ages,” “The lady of the house has been missing for three days,” and “Identifying genuine vs. fake heiresses on the loose,” and I possess extensive experience in corporate warfare, ground operations, and online PR battles.
With such an outstanding track record as a top-tier butler, I should be able to handle any tycoon family with ease.
However, after starting the job, I discovered that the “domineering CEO syndrome” in the Wayne family seems to be far more severe than I had imagined.
My employer, Mr. Wayne, is a textbook playboy and a notorious social butterfly who frequents Gotham City’s c*cktail parties. He comes and goes as he pleases, often returning home drunk and covered in bruises, with no one knowing where he’s been up to.
…Anyway, I’ve hardly ever seen him show up for board meetings.
While I’ve given up on the father, the Wayne brothers aren’t much better.
The eldest is beyond reproach—a respectable, handsome man with a government job, a true public servant.
The second son’s situation is a bit unusual. Fearing retribution from enemies, he’s been faking his death to the outside world and currently runs a small business on his own.
But from what I’ve observed, this kid might actually be the local crime boss.
The third son is a workhorse with a staggering net worth. The fact that his siblings and their idiot father haven’t ended up on the streets after the bankruptcy is all thanks to him—a ruthless work machine who can work 100-hour weeks on just a single cup of coffee.
Praise him.
The fourth son’s situation is quite serious. At 13 years old, he’s a troubled teenager who carries a concealed weapon, skips school, and is a pro at getting into fights.
I believe this is likely due to the wealthy parents’ neglect of their children’s upbringing.
Oh, I forgot to mention: aside from the fourth son, who is their biological child, the other three sons were adopted by Wayne—and they’re all equally handsome little boys with black hair and blue eyes.

187683.synopsis:
Yun Qi lived his entire life only to discover, just before death, that he was living inside a “Mary Sue” transmigration novel. A silly beauty had accidentally transmigrated into a “broken mirror reunited” novel, attempting to play matchmaker for the protagonist gong and shou, only to find that everyone ended up falling for him instead.
On a dating variety show, the beautiful but dim-witted protagonist accidentally fell from a cruise ship into the sea. The men who had been fighting over him moments ago immediately scrambled to jump into the water to save him. The protagonist was eventually rescued, but the original gong and shou who were supposed to have been the ones to save him had vanished without a trace.
In the brief moment Yun Qi was pushed into the water, he caught a glimpse of an absurd truth while on the verge of death. Beneath the surface, he saw a familiar, anxious, and handsome face. The person was desperately trying to pass oxygen to him from his own mouth, though it was but a drop in the bucket. Even though they had long since parted ways, the little puppy he had raised had come to save him without a second thought.
If fate had followed its normal trajectory… it turns out we were meant to be childhood sweethearts, lovers who grew up together.
When Yun Qi woke up again, the first episode of that web-famous dating show had just ended, and the situation was at its peak intensity. The audience was in an uproar in the comments: “Ahhh, I love watching lovers turn into rivals!” “The silly little beauty wants to play matchmaker for the CP (couple), only to realize they both fell for him more drama, please!” “I want to see these childhood friends-turned-enemies fight over the cute, clumsy beauty!!!”
Yun Qi and Duan Xingge’s few remaining fans struggled to survive in the cracks of the fandom, only to be mocked by others: “Laughing to death. XingYun? Who are they? You don’t mean Yun Qi and Duan Xingge, do you? What kind of tr*sh-tier CP is that? Eat something better.” “Are the people shipping this sick? It’s obvious they both like Jiao-bao.” “If my baby’s harem could actually be together, I would eat my computer!”
However, no one expected that when the second episode began, Duan Xingge would walk straight past the protagonist and stand directly in front of Yun Qi. His eyes held a smile, yet they shimmered with a profound, unyielding intensity: “I remember… when we were little, Brother, you promised to marry me.”
Yun Qi froze. Under the shocked gaze of the entire internet, Duan Xingge continued to smile: “So now… does that still count?”
After three seconds of silence in the livestream room, the comments section and the entire internet exploded.
